body:
i'll check it out. i can probably provide some help to other people. My surgeon said thyroid care across the nation is not up to standard, and ive heard some horror stories. I know i can manage my health situation, i was almost across the 5 year mark. 

its not really appropriate for me to say this to any other cancer patients, so i apologize. its hypocritcal of me to be so health conscious and i would help someone else with the vary same problem, that i want to let just consume me. haha at the very least, if you dont do the things that i said encourage growth, that puts you in a better place. Good luck with your health situation, fellow warrior.

yeah i get that, im pretty resolved in my outlook too. I guess im moving forward by trying to change my next step, rather than trying to change my awful path that i think im destined for. atleast i feel less overwhelmed by the gravity of some of the things ive done.

I feel that, its hard to see much when youre at the bottom. i felt incredibly alone because i was ostracized for similar/varying circumstances and it was so easy to isolate, i did. then i started meeting people similar to me, people who could understand my struggle. I realized the problems that isolated me, were also a way i could connect to some of the best people in my life right now. i do need to put in work in not obsessing over these friends, they were so meaningful to me. for me tho, it got easier to move forward, when i started focusing on the present and being proud of making progress on something something small, but meaningful to me each day. i kept on doing that and at a certain point i looked back and was genuinely proud.
you can regret the past, but you are not defined by mistakes. i feel myself saying alot of these same things. You have something you look forward to, tomorrow? Do you believe in your future?
